title: deploy-monitor config
description: Per-repository configuration for the deploy-monitor routine. Lives at .claude/deploy-monitor.json in the monitored repository.

name.description: Short name of the service, used in titles and markers.

description.description: One sentence about the stack, shown to the agent.

platform.description: Picks the platform profile: which response headers mean a crash, which CLI reads build and runtime logs, which env var holds the token.

platformScope.description: Platform-specific identifiers the log commands need (never secrets).

deployModel.description: One sentence: how a commit becomes a production deployment. Default is derived from platform and defaultBranch.

waitMinutesAfterMerge.description: How long a build takes; the merge-triggered run waits this long before the first probe.

retryMinutes.description: Re-probe delay before a failure is declared.

url.description: Primary production URL. A failure here is a real failure.

secondaryUrls.description: Custom domains etc. Informational until the primary also fails.

projectId.description: Platform project id (Vercel prj_..., Fly app name, Lambda function name).

meaning.description: Why this status proves health, e.g. 'the guard rejected us, so the function booted'.

bootRepro.description: Shell command that boots the target locally in production mode so a fail-fast names what is missing (names only).

test.description: Command prefix; the agent appends changed test paths.

workflow.description: Name of the GitHub Actions workflow that must be green on the default branch.

path.description: Committed API contract (OpenAPI etc.) to diff between deploys.

consumer.description: Who breaks when it changes, e.g. the web repo.

repoRules.description: Rules from the repo's CLAUDE.md the agent must obey, in one or two sentences.

knownFailureModes.description: Repo-specific causes seen before, one line each; the classifier checks them first.

runbookLinks.description: Paths or URLs the suggested fix should point to.

assignees.description: GitHub logins to assign issues to. Empty = the PR author.

pushNotification.description: Send a mobile push from the routine on failure (cloud routines only).

successComment.description: Post a short verified comment on the PR after a healthy merge-triggered run.

bodySections.description: Headings the PR body must contain, from the repo's PR template.

routine.description: Cloud routine settings used by the skill when it creates the routine.

cron.description: Daily sweep, UTC. Minimum interval is one hour.

environmentId.description: Cloud environment id (env_...). Asked for if missing.

connectors.description: Names of claude.ai connectors to keep attached (e.g. Slack). Everything else is removed.
